verdict.rationale: Adyen offers building blocks for background automation: webhooks push asynchronous outcomes so you don't have to poll, and the Management API lets you automate terminal management such as ordering terminals by API request. It has no documented native feature for configuring automations that run autonomously, so you must build and host the automation logic yourself. Missing for 10: built-in automation or rules engine, scheduled or background jobs configurable in the product, agent-driven autonomous workflows, independent corroboration.
